title: FlashReFocus: Interactive Image Refocusing in Seconds
abstract: arXiv:2610.23297v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Single-image refocusing changes the focal plane and depth of field of a photograph after capture. It is inherently interactive: users try many focal points and blur strengths on one image, so each edit should be fast and change only the blur. Recent generative methods, however, rerun large diffusion models for every edit. We observe that the two sub-problems differ in kind: recovering the all-in-focus image is ill-posed and needs a generative prior, whereas rendering blur is largely determined by depth and the focal plane. We therefore propose FlashReFocus, which runs diffusion once per photograph and renders every edit with a lightweight network. To address the ill-posed restoration, a one-step diffusion deblurrer with a decoder refiner recovers fine detail efficiently while balancing fidelity and perceptual quality. translated_title: FlashReFocus：秒级交互式图像重新对焦
translated_abstract: 单图像重新对焦是在拍摄后改变照片的焦平面和景深。这本质上是交互式的：用户会在同一张图像上尝试多个焦点和模糊强度，因此每次编辑都应该快速且只改变模糊。然而，近期的生成式方法为每次编辑都重新运行大型扩散模型。我们观察到这两个子问题在性质上有所不同：恢复全清晰图像是一个病态问题，需要生成先验；而渲染模糊在很大程度上由深度和焦平面决定。因此，我们提出 FlashReFocus，它对每张照片只运行一次扩散过程，然后用轻量级网络渲染每次编辑。为解决病态恢复问题，带有解码器精炼器的单步扩散去模糊器在平衡保真度和感知质量的同时高效恢复精细细节。为实现精确控制，渲染器以显式散焦图为条件，并使用散焦偏置注意力，这使得……
tldr: FlashReFocus 对每张照片仅运行一次扩散模型来恢复全清晰图像，再用基于显式散焦图条件的轻量级网络渲染每次编辑，从而实现秒级的交互式图像重新对焦。
en_tdlr: FlashReFocus achieves interactive single-image refocusing in seconds by running diffusion only once per photograph to recover the all-in-focus image and rendering each edit with a lightweight network conditioned on an explicit defocus map.
